claim: Homes within 400 m of any generator count as elevated noise/visual exposure
quote: Assumed 400 m screening radius from generators to residential receptors.

precedents.claim: Planning precedent: generator plant refused for residential noise
precedents.quote: Plant generating continuous tonal noise at the residential boundary was refused where stand-off could not be shown.

precedents.claim: Planning precedent: halls reduced for visual bulk on residential edge
precedents.quote: Halls facing residential streets were required to step back and screen so massing did not dominate the street scene.

precedents.claim: Planning precedent: insufficient buffer between plant and homes
precedents.quote: Applications placing generators within a few hundred metres of homes without a demonstrated buffer were refused.

precedents.claim: Planning precedent: capacity retained while plant is relocated
precedents.quote: Re-plans that kept IT halls and grid connection on site while moving noisy plant were accepted with conditions.
